subject: Logic's Track > Sort Tracks by submenu leaves
question: Which sort criteria actually reorder the arrangement?

reverify.command: With 3 plain audio tracks not in name order: read the Edit menu undo entry, click Track > Sort Tracks by > 트랙 이름, re-read the undo entry and the order. A real sort leaves «트랙 정렬 실행 취소».
reverify.expected: no undo entry is created and the order does not move
reverify.cost: ~2 min; no script because driving that menu is what the product does, and a copy here would test the copy

method: Three plain audio tracks. For each leaf: read the Edit menu's undo entry, click the leaf, re-read the undo entry and the track order. A real sort leaves «트랙 정렬 실행 취소»; a no-op leaves whatever was there before. Reproduced from two starting orders and through both AXPress and a System Events click.

observations.note: not name-sorted, so it should have moved

conclusion: Sorting works for 악기 이름 and 생성일 and performs no operation at all for 트랙 이름 — no undo entry, no reorder, from an order that was demonstrably not name-sorted. All seven leaves report AXEnabled = true, so a disabled-item guard cannot catch it. The three channel criteria plausibly tie on these tracks and are not evidence either way.
limits: Three plain audio tracks with no MIDI or output-channel variation, so the three channel criteria were never given a case where they should move.
One Logic build. A future build may fix 트랙 이름.
On plain audio tracks 악기 이름 happened to produce name order; that is an observation about these tracks, not a documented equivalence.
